connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 %% Estilização para espelhar as cores da imagem original
 classDef config fill:#ffe6cc,stroke:#d79b00,color:#000000
 classDef data fill:#dae8fc,stroke:#6c8ebf,color:#000000
 classDef engine fill:#f5f5f5,stroke:#666666,color:#000000
 classDef constraints fill:#f8cecc,stroke:#b85450,color:#000000
 classDef scoring fill:#d5e8d4,stroke:#82b366,color:#000000
 classDef decision fill:#e1d5e7,stroke:#9673a6,color:#000000
 classDef output fill:#e1d5e7,stroke:#9673a6,color:#000000

 subgraph CONFIGURATION [CONFIGURATION]
 direction TB
 C1[\"Operational Mode<br>balanced / sustainable<br>emergency_latency / emergency_cost\"]
 C2[\"Weights<br>w=Latency, w=Carbon, w=Cost\"]
 C1 --> C2
 end
 class CONFIGURATION config

 subgraph DATA_INPUT [DATA INPUT]
 direction TB
 DI1[\"Workload<br>CPU, Latency Threshold,<br>Priority\"]
 DI2[\"Regions/Data Centers<br>Renewable %, Carbon, Cost,<br>Latency, CPU\"]
 end
 class DATA_INPUT data

 subgraph DECISION_ENGINE [DECISION ENGINE]
 direction TB
 DE1[\"decide_best_region\"]

 subgraph HARD_CONSTRAINTS [Hard Constraints]
 direction TB
 HC1[\"Latency < 2000ms\"]
 HC2[\"CPU Available >= 1.2*Required\"]
 HC3[\"Region Status = active\"]
 HC1 --- HC2 --- HC3
 end
 class HARD_CONSTRAINTS constraints

 subgraph SCORING_FUNCTIONS [Scoring Functions]
 direction TB
 SF1[\"calculate_latency_score<br>S = 1 - lat/threshold\"]
 SF2[\"calculate_carbon_score<br>S = 0.7*renewable + 0.3*1-intensity\"]
 SF3[\"calculate_cost_score<br>S = 1 - cost_relative\"]
 SF4[\"calculate_final_score<br>Score = w*Sl + w*Sc + w*S$\"]
 end
 class SCORING_FUNCTIONS scoring

 DE1 --> HARD_CONSTRAINTS
 HARD_CONSTRAINTS -->|Valid Regions| SCORING_FUNCTIONS
 end
 class DECISION_ENGINE engine

 subgraph DECISION [DECISION]
 direction TB
 D1[\"Selected Region<br>Highest Score\"]
 D2[\"Evaluations<br>All Scores + Violations\"]
 end
 class DECISION decision

 subgraph OUTPUT_GRP [OUTPUT]
 direction TB
 O1[\"Migration Allocates:<br>Workload -> Region\"]
 O2[\"Metrics<br>Latency, Renewable %, Cost,<br>Success\"]
 O3[\"Logs/Results<br>CSV, Graphs, Tables\"]
 O2 --> O3
 end
 class OUTPUT_GRP output

 %% Conexões principais (Fora dos subgrupos)
 DI1 --> DE1
 DI2 --> DE1
 C2 --> DE1

 SCORING_FUNCTIONS --> D1
 SCORING_FUNCTIONS --> D2

 D1 --> O1
 D2 --> O2",
 "config": null
